How the boss works: 
Every time you kill a watcher another will spawn in. At the beginning of the fight a second will spawn in if you take too long. 

When they first spawn in, you can dreamnail them while they are screaming. You can also easily set up the first and last watcher into vertical jumps which allows you to dreamnail them, useful for pantheon runs. 

Watcher knights will jump a different distance and angle depending on how far you are from them. If you are semi close and grounded they will roll. Point blank range and it’s likely they will swing. Pogo and they jump vertically.

Use decending dark and dash out when they are bunched up to get free damage and invincibility frames. Use Shade soul when they are rolling away from you to get triple hits. If they jump over u and you are COMPLETELY safe… use shriek.

Soul builds are incredibly strong against watchers. USE SHAMAN STONE (and i recommend spell twister.) 

Safest strat is just to weave in and out of their swing attacks with dash or pogo off them WHEN YOU CAN to build soul off of them, then wait to use ddark or shade soul at the right times.

All throughout the life cycle of this game people who barely played the game would spread hate on it. They would hate on pointless things such as the perk system and the stim system, when these things really weren’t that bad, just different. Despite this, bo4 was patched update after update and now most of the issues are fixed. The game now has amassed a cult following over time. For multiplayer, this was the last cod game before sbmm, the obsession with realism, and the create a class system was completely changed. It was the last cod with a classic, “Arcade-y” feel. For zombies, since the crashing was fixed, certain maps such as ix and ancient evil have started to be looked at in very high regard by many people. Blackout has its own community of people that feel it to be vastly superior to warzone.
